description_en: Creates or modifies an alert rule for a task
description_zh: 创建或修改任务的告警规则
name: CreateJobMonitorRule

parameters.help_en: The ID of the data migration, data synchronization, or change tracking task. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/209702.html operation to query the task ID
parameters.help_zh: 迁移、同步或订阅任务ID，可通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/209702.html获取
parameters.name: dts_job_id

parameters.help_en:
The type of the monitoring metric. Valid values:
delay: Latency.
error: Migration status.
full_timeout: Full run duration.

Default value: error. You must manually specify this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
监控项的类型，取值：
delay：延迟监控项。
error：迁移状态监控项。
full_timeout：全量运行耗时监控项。

默认值：error；需手动填入
parameters.name: type

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable the alert rule. Valid values:

Y: Enables the alert rule.
N: Disables the alert rule.

Default value: Y
parameters.help_zh:
是否启用告警规则，取值：

Y：启用。
N：不启用。

默认值：Y
parameters.name: state

parameters.help_en:
The mobile phone numbers of the contacts to receive alert notifications. Separate multiple mobile phone numbers with commas (,).
This parameter is supported only on the Alibaba Cloud China site. Only mobile phone numbers in the Chinese mainland are supported, and you can specify up to 10 mobile phone numbers.
The Alibaba Cloud International site does not support mobile phone alerts. You can only https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/175876.html
parameters.help_zh:
告警的联系人手机号码，多个手机号码以英文逗号（,）分隔。
本参数目前只支持中国站，仅支持中国内地手机号码，且最多传入10个手机号码。
国际站不支持手机告警，仅支持https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/175876.html
parameters.name: phone

parameters.help_en:
The threshold that triggers an alert.

If Type is set to delay, the unit is seconds and the value must be an integer. You can set the threshold based on your business requirements. We recommend that you set the threshold to 10 seconds or more to prevent alerts triggered by latency fluctuations caused by network conditions or database loads.

If Type is set to full_timeout, the unit is hours and the value must be an integer.

You must specify this parameter when Type is set to delay or full_timeout and State is set to Y
parameters.help_zh:
触发告警的阈值。

当Type取值为delay时，单位为秒且需为整数，可根据业务需要设置阈值，建议设置10秒以上，避免因网络、数据库负载等原因导致的延迟波动。

当Type取值为full_timeout时，单位为小时且需为整数。

当Type取值为delay或full_timeout且State取值为Y时，本参数必须传入
parameters.name: delay_rule_time

parameters.help_en: The region where the DTS instance resides. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141033.html
parameters.help_zh: DTS实例所属的地域，详情请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141033.html
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The statistical period of the incremental data verification task. Unit: minutes.

Valid values: 1, 5, 10, and 30
parameters.help_zh:
增量校验任务的统计周期，单位为分钟。

当前支持取值为1分钟、5分钟、10分钟和30分钟
parameters.name: period

parameters.help_en: The number of periods for the incremental data verification task
parameters.help_zh: 增量校验任务的周期数
parameters.name: times

parameters.help_en: The ID of the resource group
parameters.name: resource_group_id

Code.description_en: The error code. This parameter is scheduled for deprecation
Code.description_zh: 错误码，本参数即将下线

DtsJobId.description_en: The ID of the data migration, data synchronization, or change tracking task

DynamicMessage.description_en:
The dynamic error message, which is used to replace %s in the ErrMessage parameter.
If ErrMessage returns The Value of Input Parameter %s is not valid and DynamicMessage returns DtsJobId, the specified DtsJobId request parameter is invalid
DynamicMessage.description_zh:
动态错误信息，用于替换返回参数ErrMessage错误信息中的%s。
如果ErrMessage返回The Value of Input Parameter %s is not valid，且DynamicMessage返回DtsJobId，则代表所传入的请求参数DtsJobId不合法

ErrCode.description_en: The error code returned if the call fails
ErrCode.description_zh: 调用错误时返回的错误码

ErrMessage.description_en: The error message returned if the call fails
ErrMessage.description_zh: 调用错误时返回的错误信息
ErrMessage.example: The Value of Input Parameter %s is not valid.

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the request is successful. Valid values:
true: The request is successful.
false: The request fails
Success.description_zh:
请求是否成功，返回值：
true：请求成功。
false：请求失败
